# Cleanmail: Family Inbox

> Get the schedule out of your head. School and activity email becomes one short digest sorted by kid, on a calendar your household shares.

Cleanmail is an iPhone and Android app for parents. It connects to Gmail read-only, sums up email from the school, camp, and activity senders you pick (including ParentSquare and Remind email notifications) in a digest sorted by kid, turns the dates into events automatically, and keeps them in dedicated two-way sync with Google Calendar.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777857105
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zackasher.cleanmail
- On the web for existing accounts: https://app.cleanmailapp.com
- Price: 14 days free, then $6.99 a month or $68.99 a year. Renews automatically until you cancel. One plan covers a household of up to 4 people.
- Made by Calibrate LLC. Not affiliated with Clean Email (inbox cleanup) or CleanMail.dev.
